reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first helper and the existing AccountSyncSource type, adding one guard shared by all link handlers.

duplication.why: The uniqueness rule is defined once; each handler only passes its provider, account id and upgradingId.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers that call it, consistent with the file's structure.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Typed named-parameter guard with tests covering closed, deleted, re-link and cross-provider cases.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called at the start of all five provider link handlers.
